name: Mongo Express 1.0 with MongoDB 8.0
description: MongoDB web admin behind a password login, plus a ready MongoDB 8.0.

upstream.mongo-express: mongo-express:1.0.2-20-alpine3.19@sha256:1aae0077525133249133d42980ba23998712a1077e02ac0ac295b50a7a79d550 (mongo-express 1.0.2, Node 20, image built 2024-11-21; latest stable release)

Mongo Express.startCommand: /bin/bash -c 'set -e; export ME_CONFIG_BASICAUTH=true; U="${ME_CONFIG_BASICAUTH_USERNAME:-}"; if [ -z "$U" ]; then echo "me-start: ME_CONFIG_BASICAUTH_USERNAME is empty, using admin"; export ME_CONFIG_BASICAUTH_USERNAME=admin; fi; P="${ME_CONFIG_BASICAUTH_PASSWORD:-}"; if [ ${#P} -lt 8 ] || [ ${#P} -gt 128 ]; then echo "me-start: WARNING ME_CONFIG_BASICAUTH_PASSWORD must be 8-128 characters (got ${#P}). The login is locked with a random password."; echo "me-start: Fix: set ME_CONFIG_BASICAUTH_PASSWORD to 8-128 characters and redeploy."; export ME_CONFIG_BASICAUTH_PASSWORD="$(head -c 48 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -dc A-Za-z0-9 | head -c 40)"; fi; unset P; case "${PORT:-}" in ""|*[!0-9]*) echo "me-start: PORT=${PORT:-} is not a number, using 8081"; export PORT=8081 ;; esac; export ME_CONFIG_CONNECT_RETRIES="${ME_CONFIG_CONNECT_RETRIES:-300}"; case "$ME_CONFIG_CONNECT_RETRIES" in *[!0-9]*) export ME_CONFIG_CONNECT_RETRIES=300 ;; esac; echo "me-start: basic auth on (user $ME_CONFIG_BASICAUTH_USERNAME), listening on ${VCAP_APP_HOST:-0.0.0.0}:$PORT"; exec /sbin/tini -- /docker-entrypoint.sh mongo-express' me-start

PORT.description: Port Mongo Express listens on; the public domain and the healthcheck use it.

ME_CONFIG_BASICAUTH_PASSWORD.description: Login password, 8-128 characters (generated). Change it here and redeploy to rotate it.

ME_CONFIG_MONGODB_URL.description: MongoDB connection string (private network). Point it at another MongoDB to manage that one.

ME_CONFIG_MONGODB_ENABLE_ADMIN.description: true lists every database the connection user can see (needs an admin user); false shows only the database in the URL.

ME_CONFIG_CONNECT_RETRIES.description: Seconds to wait for MongoDB to accept connections at start.

ME_CONFIG_OPTIONS_READONLY.description: true hides every write action (insert, edit, delete, drop).

ME_CONFIG_REQUEST_SIZE.description: Largest request body (document edits and imports).

MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME.description: Root user created on the first start.

MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Root password (generated). Set on the first start only.

MONGO_URL.description: Private connection URL for other services in this project.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow MongoDB to shut down cleanly.
